name: The Watchful Path
new_mark: A watchful ochre owl checks the path before the next worker follows it.

visual_review.method: Viewed inherited PNG, generated edit, final PNG and 512px JPEG.
visual_review.limitations: Small owl details are less visible at 512px; visual review is an agent observation.

implementation.limits: Fresh complete schedules only; exact decimal arithmetic; no actual execution, optimality or real deadline guarantee.

image_generation.prompt: Preserve the inherited 1254px cave wall and every ancestral mark. Add only a small worn ochre and charcoal owl with two round eyes, wings and feet on bare upper rock. Earth pigments, visible rock texture, no hands, text, logos, numbers or frames.
image_generation.assembly: Copied the generated owl patch, feathered 6px, protecting the old red path stone with an exclusion ellipse; every pixel outside the mask is unchanged.

requirements_conflict: Followed explicit dist/line-1/25.jpg preview requirement despite general ban on pictures outside artifacts; no other new picture is outside artifacts.
authority: Local measurements and agent visual observations, not independent certification.
